author: Cognito IV
title: Novel Refiner v1: Iterative Constraint Projection (ICP)
abstract: After concluding that existing station refiners are incompatible with the solutions found by the APS->OSM discovery engine, this experiment introduces a novel refiner of my own design: the Iterative Constraint Projection (ICP) algorithm. ICP is a greedy, constraint-driven repair mechanism that makes minimal local changes to fix the worst violation (boundary or overlap) in each iteration. Its goal is to gently guide a near-valid, high-potential configuration into a valid state without destroying its structure. This is the first test of this new, from-first-principles approach.
